conditions: Available to eligible SMEs subject to the programme's current requirements.
Supports areas including automation, digitalisation, innovation and technology adoption.
Applications are subject to available funds and programme conditions.
government_support.coverage: Financing for eligible SME business activities including automation, digitalisation, innovation and technology adoption.
government_support.eligibility_note: Potentially eligible — eligibility is not guaranteed and must be confirmed against the current programme requirements.
government_support.system_use: Use as a potential financing/support option when the diagnosis indicates digitalisation, automation, innovation or technology adoption needs.

conditions: Registered under SSM with required local equity structure and active operation period.
Must engage official, approved technology service providers for digital solution procurement.
government_support.coverage: Matching grant assistance aimed at lowering the cost for micro, small, and medium enterprises adopting digital applications, cloud software, or e-invoicing.
government_support.eligibility_note: Potentially eligible — subject to verification of company profile and scheme allocation criteria.
government_support.system_use: Recommend when an SME requires co-funding support for digital tool deployment, software migration, or e-invoicing compliance.

conditions: Applicable to eligible employers and training programmes under HRD Corp requirements.
Training must satisfy the relevant HRD Corp scheme and claim requirements.
Claimability depends on the applicable training scheme, course and employer eligibility.
government_support.coverage: Support for eligible employee training and development costs under the applicable HRD Corp scheme.
government_support.eligibility_note: Potentially eligible — the system must not guarantee claimability.
government_support.system_use: Recommend when the SME's main transformation gap is employee capability, digital skills or technology adoption through training.

conditions: Subject to HRD Corp eligibility and scheme requirements.
Training and claims must comply with the applicable HRD Corp requirements.
Actual support depends on the approved training arrangement and applicable cost limits.
government_support.coverage: Training support for eligible employers under the SBL scheme.
government_support.eligibility_note: Potentially eligible — eligibility and claim amount must be confirmed with HRD Corp.
government_support.system_use: Use when the recommended transformation requires employee training or capability development.

conditions: Targeted at high-potential tech start-ups and innovative early-stage enterprises.
Must have a developed prototype or tech product ready for market commercialisation.
government_support.coverage: Conditional grant funding designed to assist tech-based start-ups in commercialising innovative products and scaling market entry.
government_support.eligibility_note: Potentially eligible — restricted strictly to early-stage technology-driven businesses.
government_support.system_use: Recommend when diagnosing a technology startup or innovative venture needing non-dilutive funds for product launch and scale.

conditions: Applicable for viable SMEs applying for commercial bank financing but lacking traditional collateral.
Subject to evaluation and credit approval by participating financial institutions.
government_support.coverage: Government guarantees on commercial loans to facilitate debt financing access for growing businesses.
government_support.eligibility_note: Potentially eligible — subject to bank credit approval and active scheme conditions.
government_support.system_use: Use when an SME has sound commercial potential and viability but faces hurdles securing traditional banking lines due to collateral limitations.
